merge_rule: case contract = base deep-merged with overrides: dicts merge recursively, any other value replaces, null deletes the key

source.evidence_provenance: generator code at the pinned revision; no evaluation outcome observed

claim.hypothesis: KL-UCB obtains a higher mean cumulative reward than UCB1 over 200 pulls on a 3-arm Bernoulli bandit with p=(0.45,0.50,0.55)
claim.intended_contribution: comparative advantage of a tighter confidence index under small gaps and a short horizon
claim.primary_endpoint: mean over seeds of (reward_KLUCB - reward_UCB1) per 200 pulls, paired by seed on shared potential-outcome tables
claim.success_threshold: paired mean difference >= +1.0 reward per 200 pulls and paired 95% CI excluding 0
claim.minimum_meaningful_effect: 1.0 reward per 200 pulls (0.5 percentage points); smaller differences are not practically relevant here

design.task_distribution: fixed arms p=(0.45,0.50,0.55); potential outcomes from seeded streams
design.policy_inputs_allowed: each policy's own past arm choices and rewards only
design.calibration_data: 200 simulated seeds 10001..10200 with arm means drawn uniformly from [0.40,0.60]; disjoint from evaluation
design.evaluation_data: seeds 1..400, never used for design or tuning
design.resources: 200 pulls per policy per seed; default constants; no tuning on evaluation seeds
design.stop_rule: single run; every seed reported; a crash invalidates the run, which is repeated once on the same seeds

comparators.primary_strong_baseline: UCB1 (Auer, Cesa-Bianchi & Fischer 2002), standard exploration constant
comparators.baseline_selection_reason: closest widely used index policy in the same capability class and budget
comparators.omitted_competitors: Thompson sampling: excluded before any outcome because the question is about confidence-index policies; recorded as a limitation
comparators.trivial_floor_controls: uniform random (expected 100 rewards per 200 pulls), reported as a floor only

feasibility.contrast_bound: possible paired difference lies in [-20,+20] rewards (200 x (0.55-0.45)); the registered +1.0 margin is inside it
feasibility.forecast_method: independent simulation on calibration seeds with different arm means
feasibility.forecast_input_provenance: calibration seeds and arm means only; evaluation seeds not run
feasibility.planned_precision: calibration paired SD about 6 rewards, so SE over 400 seeds about 0.30 and MDE (80% power, two-sided 5%) about 0.84 <= 1.0 margin
feasibility.forecast: predicted mean difference +0.6, 90% interval -0.8 to +2.1; P(threshold met) about 0.40 under the alternative, about 0.03 under a null of 0
feasibility.assumptions_and_failure_modes: independence across seeds; calibration arm means differ from evaluation arms; an implementation bug in either policy

threat_scope.positive_control: UCB1 against itself on the same seeds must give exactly 0 difference
threat_scope.negative_control: a deliberately broken KL-UCB that always pulls arm 0 must lose by a detectable margin
